evals.description: Discovers frameworks + stack and classifies repo type correctly
evals.expected_behavior: Dispatches test-discovery-agent; returns classification (service/library/cli/frontend/embedded/monorepo) + detected frameworks + compliance overlay (if any)
success_criteria: Calls test-discovery-agent via Task tool
Produces a repo_type classification
Reads tests/TESTING.md if present and honors engineer policy override
Detects monorepo and classifies per-package

evals.description: Maps all 7 taxonomy layers, classifies each as installed/partial/absent/waived, produces gap list with P0/P1/P2 severity
evals.expected_behavior: Dispatches taxonomy-mapper-agent + quality-gate-runner-agent in parallel; per-layer presence table; severity per layer-applicability.md matrix
success_criteria: Every applicable layer L1-L7 appears in report
Waived layers listed separately
Each P0 gap has a specific detail and layer reference
Install order emitted topologically (L1 → L2 → L3 → L4..L7)

evals.description: When P0/P1 gaps exist on a feat/* branch, hand off to implement-tests autonomously without prompting
evals.expected_behavior: Detects branch name; bypasses AskUserQuestion; dispatches Skill(implement-tests) with handoff payload
success_criteria: Branch detection via git branch --show-current
No AskUserQuestion invoked
Skill tool called with implement-tests and structured args
Handoff payload includes classification, p0_gaps, p1_gaps, install_order

evals.description: On main/develop/protected branches, prompt engineer via AskUserQuestion before handoff
evals.expected_behavior: Detects protected branch; invokes AskUserQuestion; only dispatches implement-tests if engineer approves
success_criteria: AskUserQuestion called with "P0/P1 gaps found. Run implement-tests now?"
On decline: prints report only, exits without handoff
On approve: proceeds with Skill(implement-tests)

evals.description: When a diff lowers coverage fail_under below policy floor, escape-scan REFUSES and halts
evals.input: audit tests (pending diff: pyproject.toml fail_under = 60 with TESTING.md coverage.line = 80)
evals.expected_behavior: Dispatches escape-detection-agent; reads floor from TESTING.md; escape-scan.sh exits 2; TEST_AUDIT.md records REFUSE; no handoff
success_criteria: escape-scan.sh reads floor from tests/TESTING.md (not hardcoded 80)
REFUSE pattern matched and reported with specific detail
Pipeline halts before Step 7 TEST_AUDIT.md write
No Skill(implement-tests) dispatched

evals.description: RTM builder applies MoSCoW precedence correctly: engineer override > explicit tag > source default > SHOULD fallback
evals.input: audit tests (RTM.md has engineer edit downgrading REQ-003 from MUST to SHOULD — hash-pinned)
evals.expected_behavior: rtm-builder-agent preserves the engineer override; does NOT re-promote REQ-003 back to MUST from the Gherkin default
success_criteria: REQ-003 row retains SHOULD tag after rebuild
No escape-scan REFUSE fires (engineer override is legitimate)
rtm_total, by_moscow.must, by_moscow.should counts reflect the override

evals.description: If harness-hash.sh --verify reports tampering, audit halts before any other work
evals.input: audit tests (features/checkout.feature modified after hash init)
evals.expected_behavior: Step 1 hash verify fails; returns HARNESS_TAMPERED; no TEST_AUDIT.md written; no handoff
success_criteria: Hash verify runs as Step 1
Mismatch returns error
No discovery or gate execution proceeds
TEST_AUDIT.md not created

evals.description: Monorepo produces per-package TESTING.md and aggregate TEST_AUDIT.md
evals.input: audit tests (repo with packages/a, packages/b, packages/c)
evals.expected_behavior: Classifies each package independently; writes packages/*/tests/TESTING.md for each; root TEST_AUDIT.md has per-package sections
success_criteria: test-discovery-agent returns monorepo: true with package list
Each package gets its own classification
Policy is per-package (can differ across packages)
Aggregate TEST_AUDIT.md has one section per package
